# Language Review Guide

Use this guide when the workflow needs a reminder of the legacy language-review responsibilities.

- TypeScript: type narrowing, nullability, async correctness, and contract drift.
- Python: type hints, import behavior, error handling, and Pythonic structure.
- Go: concurrency, explicit errors, and idiomatic package boundaries.
- Rust: ownership, lifetimes, unsafe boundaries, and error propagation.
- Report only material language-driven findings.
